title: Public Speaking
overview: This intensive program develops the confidence, structure, delivery skills and audience awareness required to communicate persuasively in professional and public settings. Participants learn to plan purposeful speeches, organize evidence and stories, use voice and body language effectively, manage presentation anxiety, adapt to different audiences, and respond confidently to questions. The program combines practical techniques with repeated speaking exercises, video-supported feedback and a final assessed presentation.
audience: Managers, supervisors, executives and emerging leaders who address teams or stakeholders.
Professionals delivering briefings, presentations, proposals, training sessions or public remarks.
Sales, customer-facing, communications and public relations personnel.
Subject-matter experts, project managers and technical professionals presenting complex information.
Anyone seeking greater confidence, clarity and influence when speaking before an audience.
methodology: Interactive mini-lectures, instructor demonstrations, individual and group speaking exercises, audience analysis workshops, message-mapping activities, storytelling drills, voice and body-language practice, slide critique, impromptu speaking, simulated Q&A sessions, peer feedback, video-supported self-review, and a capstone presentation with an individual improvement plan.
competencies: Speech planning, structuring and persuasive argumentation.
Vocal control, articulation, pacing and nonverbal communication.
Storytelling, audience engagement and clear explanation of complex ideas.
Visual aid design and professional presentation delivery.
Handling questions, interruptions and challenging audience situations.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the program, participants will be able to:
objectives: Define a clear speaking purpose and analyze audience needs and expectations.
Develop a focused central message and structure an effective opening, body and conclusion.
Use evidence, examples and stories to make speeches memorable and credible.
Control voice, pace, pauses, posture, gestures and eye contact to strengthen delivery.
Apply practical methods to reduce speaking anxiety and maintain composure.
Design and use visual aids that support rather than distract from the message.
Deliver persuasive, informative and impromptu speeches suited to the situation.
Manage audience questions, objections and unexpected interruptions professionally.
Assess their own speaking performance and implement a measurable development plan.
